default.en: Nakshatra not classified — treated as neutral.

meta.note: nakshatra index 0 = Ashwini … 26 = Revati. Each row carries gana and group so that other rules can reference them through exceptions.

translations.en: Ashwini — kshipra (swift), deva gana. Acceptable but light for a samskara meant to endure.
translations.hi: अश्विनी — क्षिप्र, देव गण। ग्राह्य किन्तु स्थायित्व हेतु हल्का।

rules.interpretation: Swift nakshatras suit quick undertakings; Garbhadhana asks for sthira (fixed) or mridu (soft) qualities, so Ashwini is merely acceptable.

translations.en: Bharani — ugra (fierce), ruled by Yama. Rejected for Garbhadhana.
translations.hi: भरणी — उग्र नक्षत्र, यम स्वामी। गर्भाधान हेतु वर्जित।

rules.interpretation: Yama's nakshatra is associated with restraint and death; it is uniformly excluded from conception muhurtas.

translations.en: Krittika — tikshna/ugra, ruled by Agni. Avoided.
translations.hi: कृत्तिका — तीक्ष्ण/उग्र, अग्नि स्वामी। वर्जित।

rules.interpretation: Sharp, burning nakshatra; unsuited to a rite whose aim is gentle nourishment.

translations.en: Rohini — dhruva (fixed), the Moon's own exaltation star. Foremost for Garbhadhana.
translations.hi: रोहिणी — ध्रुव नक्षत्र, चन्द्र की उच्च राशि में। गर्भाधान हेतु सर्वश्रेष्ठ।

rules.interpretation: Rohini means 'the growing one'. Dhruva nakshatras give permanence, and the Moon — karaka of conception — is exalted here. Named first in almost every list.

translations.en: Mrigashira — mridu (soft), deva gana. Excellent for conception.
translations.hi: मृगशिरा — मृदु नक्षत्र, देव गण। गर्भाधान हेतु उत्तम।

rules.interpretation: Mridu nakshatras are gentle and nourishing — the temperament classically sought for this samskara.

translations.en: Ardra — tikshna, ruled by Rudra. Rejected.
translations.hi: आर्द्रा — तीक्ष्ण नक्षत्र, रुद्र स्वामी। वर्जित।

rules.interpretation: Rudra's star signifies storm and dissolution; excluded from all auspicious beginnings.

translations.en: Punarvasu — chara (movable), ruled by Aditi, deva gana. Favourable.
translations.hi: पुनर्वसु — चर नक्षत्र, अदिति स्वामी, देव गण। अनुकूल।

rules.interpretation: Aditi is the mother of the gods; the star signifies renewal and return of prosperity. Widely accepted for Garbhadhana.

translations.en: Pushya — kshipra/laghu, ruled by Brihaspati. Nourishing and auspicious.
translations.hi: पुष्य — क्षिप्र/लघु, बृहस्पति स्वामी। पोषक व शुभ।

rules.interpretation: Pushya means 'nourishment' and is called the best of nakshatras for most purposes. Its exclusion applies to marriage, not to Garbhadhana.

translations.en: Ashlesha — tikshna, sarpa (serpent) deity, rakshasa gana. Rejected.
translations.hi: आश्लेषा — तीक्ष्ण, सर्प देवता, राक्षस गण। वर्जित।

rules.interpretation: A gandanta star of entanglement and poison; uniformly excluded.

translations.en: Magha — ugra, presided by the Pitris. Avoided for conception.
translations.hi: मघा — उग्र नक्षत्र, पितृ देवता। गर्भाधान हेतु वर्जित।

rules.interpretation: The nakshatra of the ancestors, used for shraddha rites rather than for beginning new life.

translations.en: Purva Phalguni — ugra, ruled by Bhaga. Avoided.
translations.hi: पूर्वा फाल्गुनी — उग्र नक्षत्र, भग स्वामी। वर्जित।

rules.interpretation: The three Purva stars are ugra and are set aside for auspicious samskaras.

translations.en: Uttara Phalguni — dhruva (fixed), one of the Uttara-traya. Excellent.
translations.hi: उत्तरा फाल्गुनी — ध्रुव नक्षत्र, उत्तरात्रय। उत्तम।

rules.interpretation: The Uttara-traya (U.Phalguni, U.Ashadha, U.Bhadrapada) are dhruva — what begins under them endures. Explicitly recommended.

translations.en: Hasta — kshipra, ruled by Savitr. Among the foremost for Garbhadhana.
translations.hi: हस्त — क्षिप्र, सवितृ स्वामी। गर्भाधान हेतु श्रेष्ठ।

rules.interpretation: Named in the standard Garbhadhana list alongside Rohini, Anuradha and Shravana.

translations.en: Chitra — mridu-tikshna, ruled by Tvashtr. Mixed; usable only with strong support.
translations.hi: चित्रा — मृदु-तीक्ष्ण, त्वष्टा स्वामी। मिश्र; प्रबल सहयोग पर ही ग्राह्य।

rules.interpretation: Classical opinion is divided — some lists include Chitra, others exclude it. Scored as mixed rather than forced either way.

translations.en: Swati — chara, ruled by Vayu. Favourable.
translations.hi: स्वाति — चर नक्षत्र, वायु स्वामी। अनुकूल।

rules.interpretation: Appears in the Garbhadhana list in several commentaries; its movable nature makes it good but not foremost.

translations.en: Vishakha — mishra (mixed), rakshasa gana. Not recommended.
translations.hi: विशाखा — मिश्र नक्षत्र, राक्षस गण। अनुशंसित नहीं।

rules.interpretation: Mishra nakshatras suit mixed or worldly activity rather than a purificatory samskara.

translations.en: Anuradha — mridu (soft), ruled by Mitra, deva gana. Excellent.
translations.hi: अनुराधा — मृदु नक्षत्र, मित्र स्वामी, देव गण। उत्तम।

rules.interpretation: Mitra's star of friendship and devotion; soft, nourishing and explicitly recommended.

translations.en: Jyeshtha — tikshna, ruled by Indra, gandanta at its close. Rejected.
translations.hi: ज्येष्ठा — तीक्ष्ण, इन्द्र स्वामी, गण्डान्त। वर्जित।

rules.interpretation: Sharp nakshatra ending in gandanta; excluded from conception muhurtas.

translations.en: Mula — tikshna, ruled by Nirriti, gandanta at its start. Rejected.
translations.hi: मूल — तीक्ष्ण, निर्ऋति स्वामी, गण्डान्त। वर्जित।

rules.interpretation: Nirriti's star of dissolution; classically the strongest nakshatra prohibition for conception and birth.

translations.en: Purva Ashadha — ugra, ruled by Apas. Avoided.
translations.hi: पूर्वाषाढ़ा — उग्र नक्षत्र, आपः स्वामी। वर्जित।

rules.interpretation: One of the three Purva (ugra) stars set aside for samskaras.

translations.en: Uttara Ashadha — dhruva, one of the Uttara-traya. Excellent.
translations.hi: उत्तराषाढ़ा — ध्रुव नक्षत्र, उत्तरात्रय। उत्तम।

rules.interpretation: Fixed nakshatra of the Vishvedevas; what is begun under it is lasting.

translations.en: Shravana — chara-dhruva, ruled by Vishnu, deva gana. Excellent.
translations.hi: श्रवण — विष्णु स्वामी, देव गण। उत्तम।

rules.interpretation: Vishnu's star, protective and sustaining; a standard member of the Garbhadhana list.

translations.en: Dhanishtha — chara, ruled by the Vasus. Favourable.
translations.hi: धनिष्ठा — चर नक्षत्र, वसु स्वामी। अनुकूल।

rules.interpretation: Wealth- and abundance-giving. Note that its second half begins the Panchaka span (see mc_prohibited.json).

translations.en: Shatabhisha — chara, ruled by Varuna. Acceptable; healing in nature.
translations.hi: शतभिषा — चर नक्षत्र, वरुण स्वामी। ग्राह्य; भैषज्य प्रकृति।

rules.interpretation: Varuna's star, associated with healing — helpful where conception has been difficult, though it lies in the Panchaka span.

translations.en: Purva Bhadrapada — ugra, ruled by Aja Ekapada. Avoided.
translations.hi: पूर्वा भाद्रपद — उग्र नक्षत्र, अज एकपाद स्वामी। वर्जित।

rules.interpretation: The last of the three Purva (ugra) stars; excluded from auspicious samskaras.

translations.en: Uttara Bhadrapada — dhruva, one of the Uttara-traya. Excellent.
translations.hi: उत्तरा भाद्रपद — ध्रुव नक्षत्र, उत्तरात्रय। उत्तम।

rules.interpretation: Fixed and deeply auspicious; completes the Uttara-traya recommended for Garbhadhana.

translations.en: Revati — mridu, ruled by Pushan, deva gana. Excellent and protective.
translations.hi: रेवती — मृदु नक्षत्र, पूषा स्वामी, देव गण। उत्तम व रक्षक।

rules.interpretation: Pushan is the nourisher and protector of travellers — an apt quality for the beginning of a life. Its final pada is gandanta and slightly weaker.

translations.en: Ashwini — kshipra (swift), deva gana. Acceptable for marriage.
translations.hi: अश्विनी — क्षिप्र, देव गण। विवाह हेतु ग्राह्य।

rules.interpretation: Swift nakshatras are acceptable for marriage though not ideal; Ashwini's healing nature is a positive quality.

translations.en: Bharani — ugra (fierce), ruled by Yama. Rejected for marriage.
translations.hi: भरणी — उग्र नक्षत्र, यम स्वामी। विवाह हेतु वर्जित।

rules.interpretation: Yama's nakshatra is uniformly excluded from marriage muhurtas.

translations.en: Krittika — tikshna/ugra, ruled by Agni. Avoided for marriage.
translations.hi: कृत्तिका — तीक्ष्ण/उग्र, अग्नि स्वामी। विवाह हेतु वर्जित।

rules.interpretation: Sharp, burning nakshatra; unsuited to marriage which seeks harmony.

translations.en: Rohini — dhruva (fixed), the Moon's exaltation star. Foremost for marriage.
translations.hi: रोहिणी — ध्रुव नक्षत्र, चन्द्र उच्च। विवाह हेतु सर्वश्रेष्ठ।

rules.interpretation: Rohini means 'the growing one'. Fixed nakshatras give permanence to the bond. Named first in the marriage nakshatra list.

translations.en: Mrigashira — mridu (soft), deva gana. Excellent for marriage.
translations.hi: मृगशिरा — मृदु नक्षत्र, देव गण। विवाह हेतु उत्तम।

rules.interpretation: Mridu nakshatras are gentle and nourishing — ideal for establishing a harmonious household.

translations.en: Ardra — tikshna, ruled by Rudra. Rejected for marriage.
translations.hi: आर्द्रा — तीक्ष्ण, रुद्र स्वामी। विवाह हेतु वर्जित।

rules.interpretation: Rudra's star signifies storm and dissolution; excluded from marriage.

translations.en: Punarvasu — chara, ruled by Aditi, deva gana. Favourable for marriage.
translations.hi: पुनर्वसु — चर नक्षत्र, अदिति स्वामी, देव गण। विवाह हेतु अनुकूल।

rules.interpretation: Aditi is the mother of the gods; the star signifies renewal and return of prosperity.

translations.en: Pushya — SPECIFICALLY FORBIDDEN for marriage despite being otherwise auspicious.
translations.hi: पुष्य — विवाह हेतु विशेष रूप से वर्जित, अन्यथा शुभ होने पर भी।

rules.interpretation: Pushya is the best nakshatra for most purposes, but it is explicitly forbidden for marriage. The classical reason is that the bride would become barren or the marriage would be unfaithful.

translations.en: Ashlesha — tikshna, sarpa (serpent) deity, rakshasa gana. Rejected.
translations.hi: आश्लेषा — तीक्ष्ण, सर्प देवता, राक्षस गण। वर्जित।

rules.interpretation: A gandanta star of entanglement and poison; excluded from marriage.

translations.en: Magha — ugra, presided by the Pitris. Last quarter only acceptable for marriage.
translations.hi: मघा — उग्र नक्षत्र, पितृ देवता। केवल अंतिम चरण विवाह हेतु ग्राह्य।

rules.interpretation: The nakshatra of the ancestors; only its fourth pada is used for marriage in some traditions.

translations.en: Purva Phalguni — ugra, ruled by Bhaga. Avoided for marriage.
translations.hi: पूर्वा फाल्गुनी — उग्र नक्षत्र, भग स्वामी। विवाह हेतु वर्जित।

rules.interpretation: The three Purva stars are ugra and are set aside for marriage.

translations.en: Uttara Phalguni — dhruva (fixed), one of the Uttara-traya. Excellent for marriage.
translations.hi: उत्तरा फाल्गुनी — ध्रुव नक्षत्र, उत्तरात्रय। विवाह हेतु उत्तम।

rules.interpretation: The Uttara-traya are fixed nakshatras — marriages performed under them endure. Aryaman, lord of this star, presides over marriage.

translations.en: Hasta — kshipra, ruled by Savitr. Among the foremost for marriage.
translations.hi: हस्त — क्षिप्र, सवितृ स्वामी। विवाह हेतु श्रेष्ठ।

rules.interpretation: Named in the standard marriage nakshatra list. The 'hand' nakshatra signifies skill and giving.

translations.en: Chitra — mridu-tikshna, ruled by Tvashtr. Mixed; usable with strong support.
translations.hi: चित्रा — मृदु-तीक्ष्ण, त्वष्टा स्वामी। मिश्र; प्रबल सहयोग पर ही ग्राह्य।

rules.interpretation: Classical opinion is divided — some lists include Chitra, others exclude it.

translations.en: Swati — chara, ruled by Vayu. Favourable for marriage.
translations.hi: स्वाति — चर नक्षत्र, वायु स्वामी। विवाह हेतु अनुकूल।

rules.interpretation: Appears in the marriage nakshatra list in most commentaries; its independent nature suits new beginnings.

translations.en: Vishakha — mishra (mixed), rakshasa gana. Not recommended for marriage.
translations.hi: विशाखा — मिश्र नक्षत्र, राक्षस गण। विवाह हेतु अनुशंसित नहीं।

rules.interpretation: Mishra nakshatras suit mixed or worldly activity rather than a samskara.

translations.en: Anuradha — mridu (soft), ruled by Mitra, deva gana. Excellent for marriage.
translations.hi: अनुराधा — मृदु नक्षत्र, मित्र स्वामी, देव गण। विवाह हेतु उत्तम।

rules.interpretation: Mitra's star of friendship and devotion; soft, nourishing and explicitly recommended for marriage.

translations.en: Jyeshtha — tikshna, ruled by Indra, gandanta at its close. Rejected.
translations.hi: ज्येष्ठा — तीक्ष्ण, इन्द्र स्वामी, गण्डान्त। वर्जित।

rules.interpretation: Sharp nakshatra ending in gandanta; excluded from marriage.

translations.en: Mula — tikshna, ruled by Nirriti. First pada only acceptable for marriage.
translations.hi: मूल — तीक्ष्ण, निर्ऋति स्वामी। केवल प्रथम चरण विवाह हेतु ग्राह्य।

rules.interpretation: Generally avoided, but some traditions permit the first pada for marriage when other factors are strong.

translations.en: Purva Ashadha — ugra, ruled by Apas. Avoided for marriage.
translations.hi: पूर्वाषाढ़ा — उग्र नक्षत्र, आपः स्वामी। विवाह हेतु वर्जित।

rules.interpretation: One of the three Purva (ugra) stars set aside for marriage.

translations.en: Uttara Ashadha — dhruva, one of the Uttara-traya. Good for marriage.
translations.hi: उत्तराषाढ़ा — ध्रुव नक्षत्र, उत्तरात्रय। विवाह हेतु शुभ।

rules.interpretation: Fixed nakshatra of the Vishvedevas; what is begun under it is lasting.

translations.en: Shravana — chara-dhruva, ruled by Vishnu, deva gana. Good for marriage.
translations.hi: श्रवण — विष्णु स्वामी, देव गण। विवाह हेतु शुभ।

rules.interpretation: Vishnu's star, protective and sustaining; a member of the marriage list in many texts.

translations.en: Dhanishtha — chara, ruled by the Vasus. Mixed for marriage.
translations.hi: धनिष्ठा — चर नक्षत्र, वसु स्वामी। विवाह हेतु मिश्र।

rules.interpretation: Wealth-giving but its second half begins the Panchaka span; use with caution.

translations.en: Shatabhisha — chara, ruled by Varuna. Mixed; lies in the Panchaka span.
translations.hi: शतभिषा — चर नक्षत्र, वरुण स्वामी। मिश्र; पंचक में।

rules.interpretation: Varuna's star; acceptable only when other factors are strong and Panchaka is mitigated.

translations.en: Purva Bhadrapada — ugra, ruled by Aja Ekapada. Avoided for marriage.
translations.hi: पूर्वा भाद्रपद — उग्र नक्षत्र, अज एकपाद स्वामी। विवाह हेतु वर्जित।

rules.interpretation: The last of the three Purva (ugra) stars; excluded from marriage.

translations.en: Uttara Bhadrapada — dhruva, one of the Uttara-traya. Good for marriage.
translations.hi: उत्तरा भाद्रपद — ध्रुव नक्षत्र, उत्तरात्रय। विवाह हेतु शुभ।

rules.interpretation: Fixed and deeply auspicious; completes the Uttara-traya recommended for marriage.

translations.en: Revati — mridu, ruled by Pushan, deva gana. Excellent for marriage.
translations.hi: रेवती — मृदु नक्षत्र, पूषा स्वामी, देव गण। विवाह हेतु उत्तम।

rules.interpretation: Pushan is the nourisher and protector; an apt quality for beginning married life. Its final pada is gandanta and slightly weaker.
